intro.fr: Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Buried Things sort Cursed Words en 2026.
text.en: Buried Things releases Cursed Words in 2026.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't.
text.en: The GitHub repository JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago, home of the Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.0.0 (préversion).
text.en: The first version, v0.0.0 (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.5.5, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (16 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.5.5 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (16 versions released).

text.fr: Comme beaucoup de jeux, Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't rejoint Archipelago par un APWorld non officiel : un fichier .apworld distribué à part, que chaque joueur ajoute lui-même à son installation pour l'intégrer à un multiworld.
text.en: Like many games, Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't joins Archipelago through an unofficial APWorld: a .apworld file distributed separately, which each player adds to their own install to bring it into a multiworld.
